scope: Reuse Zero player 3C and camera in Opus; retain the native rule engine and UICreator HUD

implementation.character: ADWOHero : ACleanNetworkCharacter, original UCleanNetworkMovement and prediction adapter
implementation.animation: Original UCleanMotionAnimInstance, ChannelMobile graph, 26 motion-matching databases, saved montages, IK and pose-continuity node
implementation.wizard: Existing FingerRig / StanceFix20261018 attached-parent retarget, scale 1.1875
implementation.dodge: Original DA_Roll_Mocap114 eight directions, authored play rate/distance, CMC root motion and bounded aim recovery; no teleport
implementation.cast: Input starts the original Zero montage and snapshots the selected plan/aim. Only its source Attack Release notify commits one native DWRules cast and cost per action revision. Movement, hurt, death, replacement, skill switching and input modals cancel unreleased intent. Held input may chain only after the authored Action End marker. Native cooldown, payment and damage remain authoritative.
implementation.ruleTarget: Invisible attached target preserves the original feet+60cm sphere with radius 45cm; registered before creating the native player session; real CMC velocity is published for the existing moving-player query
implementation.geometry: AS static-object sphere queries exclude the physical Pawn capsule; native rule hit detection remains authoritative

camera.follow: Original CleanCameraFollow, PostPhysics; exact linear-target integration, reset after teleport

input.readyState: manual battle start, movement permitted after scene is ready

implementation.assetCompilation: Opus editor asset concurrency 2, texture concurrency 1, following observed first-load texture compilation memory pressure; texture quality is unchanged
implementation.preparation: Movement suspended until assets and geometry are ready; CharacterMovement resumes walking through the normal movement entry point
implementation.lootMovement: Existing navigation route and CMC are retained; a pickup click uses the same movement-cancel transition
implementation.targeting: Manual aim resolves a live registered enemy within its existing rule-target footprint; auto aim selects a live registered, non-staged enemy. Empty ground and stale points cannot start an action or set the native casting flag. Wind-up retains the selected enemy object, and invalidation is checked both each tick (including pause/preparation transitions) and at Attack Release. Target loss cancels movement lock and intent without payment or retargeting that action. Rule formulas, native hit geometry and target distances are unchanged.
